frozen_pilot.rule: Establish the frozen object by immutable identity without opening prior Pilot scientific narrative before its authorized reveal point.

pre_freeze_prohibited: docs/research/revealed or expected-output material not listed in pre_freeze_allowed_inputs
any prior chat/thread reasoning about evaluator A or evaluator B
required_sequence: In a genuinely fresh context, inspect only the contract and three dummy data inputs listed above.
Implement the evaluator contract independently without inspecting evaluator A/B, canonicalizer, tests, expected outputs, prior implementation reasoning, or prior comparison results.
Freeze the independent implementation and record its exact bytes/hash/commit before any comparison surface is opened.

If outputs/semantics do not agree, preserve the disagreement. Do not repair the frozen independent implementation after exposure and still call the same run independent.

evaluator_independence_reproduction.scientific_non_claim: This dummy evaluator reproduction does not establish benchmark validity, scientific adjudication validity, Pilot methodology support, or Evidence Bundler retrieval performance.

preferred: Read this v2 manifest and v1 manifest by exact path/ref.
